cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. For the party report, what time did you arrive, leave, and visit the kitchen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It's the only room missing from the timeline.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll give the cake its own line. First, your kitchen time.

mechanism: A controls a party timeline's sequence so B fills missing movements without A openly identifying the cake-related answer as the priority.
confusable: D136 elicits motive with personal bait; D174 elicits missing factual entries while concealing which one matters most.
comparison: A potentially embarrassing kitchen visit differs from a shared-car damage inquiry and inconvenient log retrieval.
seedUse: Keep suspected kitchen entry and cake, but avoid asking only the obvious target after insisting on general completeness.
